sections.html: The Rector’s Office is a structural unit of the University providing organizational, information and analytical, and administrative support to the Rector, facilitating the implementation of the University’s Development Strategy, and coordinating interaction between the Rector and the University’s structural units, staff, and partners.

sections.heading: Key responsibilities
sections.html:
• providing organizational and information and analytical support to the Rector;
  • supporting the implementation of the University’s strategic goals and objectives;
  • coordinating and monitoring the implementation of strategic objectives and performance indicators;
  • preparing and consolidating informational, analytical, and reporting materials;
  • facilitating effective internal management interaction and official communication;
  • supporting the Rector’s schedule and organizing appointments with citizens and University staff.
